events.title: GRIDHACK DEMO FAQ
events.summary: GRIDHACK DEMO FAQThe GRIDHACK DEMO is finally here, so we put together this FAQ to let you know what to expect.What are the contents of the demo?In the GRIDHACK DEMO, you will be able to play:STORY mode: Play the opening moments of the games story chapter, which will automatically end after a certain point is reached. This is the perfect way to start, as it will introduce you to GRIDHACKs setting, tone and a few of the characters. This also features a short tutorial on how to play nonogram games
